intro.text: A family of slimy, shell-less Rosharan animals with two bulging eyes and four long tentacles. Though they look like invertebrates, they are warm-blooded.

description.text: Sarpenthyn look like haspers without shells. Species differ in size, and a threatened sarpenthyn puffs itself up and lifts its tentacles over its head to scare enemies off.

They live mostly in central and western Roshar, squeezing into cracks to shelter from highstorms. Jah Keved has smaller kinds and Marabethia larger ones; in Alethkar and on the Shattered Plains they are so rare that Adolin had never seen one.

items.text: In a warcamp menagerie Shallan, Adolin and Kaladin saw a large Marabethian sarpenthyn in a cage made to look like a cave. Shallan touched it to check it was warm-blooded, making it rear up, and meant to sketch it; Adolin was horrified. The plaque named it the "Devil Rock".
Riding the highstorm, Dalinar saw sarpenthyn-like creatures squeezing into holes to hide from it, but he was urged to keep moving before he could look closely.
